articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs on track for the smallest monthly inflows ever
Crypto's resilience tested as oil rises after Iran strikes, Fed signals rates could still rise
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held near $64,000 despite the Fed's hawkish split, Iranian ballistic missiles and an 8% surge in oil overnight that sent the Dow down 2.2% and the Nasdaq to a three-month low.

articles.title: Bitcoin stable as Fed fave PCE inflation sees first monthly drop in six years
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and US stocks enjoyed a relief bounce as the South Korea semiconductor rout eased and US PCE inflation data conforms to year-on-year expectations.

articles.title: Crypto entering biggest consolidation phase in history, says ARK analyst
articles.snippet: ARK Invest’s Lorenzo Valente says revenue is becoming increasingly concentrated among a handful of crypto protocols, setting the stage for more mergers, acquisitions and exchange closures.
